# actionlint known-issues ratchet — files with GENUINE findings, not yet fixed.
#
# ── REDEFINED 2026-08-19 (WR #17734) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# This file used to hold 150 workflows excluded because the old 2022 linter
# (rethab/actions-lint@v1.0.0) false-positived on modern syntax it could not
# parse. That linter has been replaced by actionlint, which understands the
# `||` fallback operator, `secrets.*` outside workflow_call, and choice-typed
# inputs — so 138 of those 150 files lint clean and are now actually covered.
#
# What remains below is the opposite of the old list: these are the ONLY files
# where actionlint reports a REAL defect. They are excluded so the gate can be
# green and stay meaningful, and each one is a bug to fix, not a quirk to
# tolerate. Findings are tracked in WR #17742.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. tests/actions-lint-workflow.test.js pins its
# length; adding an entry fails the suite. Fix the workflow instead — that is
# the point of a ratchet. Never add a NEW workflow file here.
#
# ── EMPTIED 2026-08-20 (WR #17742) ───────────────────────────────────────────
# All 14 findings are fixed. actionlint 1.7.7 reports ZERO findings across all
# 227 workflows with no exclusions, so this file is now empty and the gate
# covers the entire surface.
#
# What the 14 turned out to be — none were style, all were dead or broken code:
#
#   agent-fallback.yml         `cursor_available` was never produced: no
#                              availability check, no $GITHUB_OUTPUT write, no
#                              job output. The Cursor fallback could never fire.
#   auto-error-handler.yml     `issue_url` set by a step but never exported as a
#                              job output, so the summary printed
#                              "View issue: " with nothing after it.
#   auto-reset-stuck-issues.yml  stray top-level `description:` — not a workflow
#   reset-self-heal-issue.yml    key; GitHub ignored it silently.
#   bito-ai.yml                the step consuming `steps.pr-context.outputs.url`
#                              was placed BEFORE the step that produces it.
#   budget-aware-agent.yml     four defects: `routing_reason` echoed to stdout
#                              instead of $GITHUB_OUTPUT; never exported as a
#                              job output; a step reading its OWN outputs; and
#                              `fallback-handler` reading a job it did not need.
#   dprint-check.yml           `runner` context in a job-level `if`, where it is
#                              unavailable — and redundant beside `runs-on`.
#   news-with-cache.yml        the cache key referenced a date step that ran
#                              AFTER it, so the key never rotated daily.
#   pr-review-status.yml       a step set an output "for the next job" but had
#                              no `id`, so the approval notice never fired.
#   release-banner-social.yml  `secrets` in a step-level `if`, where it is
#                              unavailable.
#   security-fleet.yml         an Actions expression inside a JS string literal
#                              — substituted by the runner, and array-valued.
#   wr-pr-creation.yml         fixed earlier by #17736; already clean.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK, and it has reached zero. Adding an entry fails
# tests/actions-lint-workflow.test.js. Fix the workflow instead.
